noCountdown:
⚠️ No personalized countdown found for you yet.

Can only be done while Skyrise Celebration is on cooldown. Click the button below to set up your personal anchor!
setupFirst: ❌ You need to set up your personal countdown first by clicking **⚙️ Set Actual Countdown**.
dmEnabled: 🔔 **DM Notifications Enabled!** You will receive a direct message when your Skyrise Celebration begins.
dmDisabled: 🔕 **DM Notifications Disabled.** You will no longer receive direct messages for this event.
removed: 🗑️ **Successfully removed your personal Firmament counter.** Run `/firmament` again anytime to set up a new anchor.
onlyCooldown: ❌ Can only be done while Skyrise Celebration is on cooldown.
invalid: ❌ Invalid input. Ensure days >= 0, hours are 0–23, and minutes are 0–59.
calibrated: ✅ Successfully calibrated your personal timer! Next celebration is set for **{d}d {h}h {m}m** from now.
dmStarting: 🎉 **Skyrise Celebration is starting now!** Use `/firmament` on {server} to manage or remove notifications.
